title: Find tokens even easier in Swaps
summary: You can now search for a Token Contract Address in Swaps to more quickly find a token, and more weekly improvements
body_markdown:
###### Improved


-


You can now search for a Token Contract Address in Swaps to more quickly find a token


###### Fixes


-


Resolved gas estimation issues for Blast and Degen chain


-


Fixed the` To` field in Activity Details for a transaction to better reflect a transaction recipient


-


Resolved` NaN` balances displayed on the Tokens tab while reloading balances


-


Fixed text overflows for alternative languages on the Tip Banner on the Tokens tab
